choices.why: A deep, generous three-seat sofa in aged dark brown leather is exactly the industrial look requested and suits the large open floor.
A solid live-edge wood top on black metal U-legs matches the brief for solid wood with black metal and echoes the exposed beams.
A tall black metal and wood etagere fits against the right wall beside the door and brings the requested dark metal and wood.
A black metal swing-arm reading lamp with brass accents is dark, industrial and works well beside the sofa, avoiding bright white.
A large rug in earthy rust and deep blue tones is big enough to anchor the sofa and table and adds warmth against the wood floor.
Dark woven textured cushions in brown and black tones suit the leather sofa and the industrial palette, used as a pair.
A dark grey pot is sized for a large plant and fits the dark-metal scheme without any shiny white.

answer.why: Aged brown leather, solid wood, black metal and earthy textiles form a cohesive industrial scheme that sits well under the warm exposed beams and wood floor. Dark tones, no glossy white, and sizes that fit the open space and the right wall.
